verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs explicitly position the RTX PRO 6000 as a way to run AI workloads (LLM fine-tuning, generative AI, autonomous agents) entirely on local hardware 'without relying on costly cloud or data center resources,' directly matching the self-hosting story, and community threads confirm real users running large local AI workloads (41k tok/s) on multi-GPU setups. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks/tutorials on full self-host deployment workflow and no detailed admin/ops documentation for large-scale self-hosted setups.
